title: Media processing pipeline
description:
Implement media normalization: images ≤1080px, videos ≤720p MP4, SHA-256 checksums, exact dedup.

DoD:
- Image resizing to max 1080px implemented
- Video transcoding to 720p MP4 implemented  
- SHA-256 checksum generation for all media
- Exact duplicate detection based on checksums
- ./scripts/check_stage1.sh includes media processing verification

- Storage connectivity check in /healthz/storage
- ./scripts/check_stage0.sh includes endpoint verification

title: Export writer with dry-run support

title: Stage 1 Soak Run — 5-day daily export + publishable rate tracking
description:
Manual operational verification: Run the system daily for 5 days and track publishable rate.

This is a HUMAN-DRIVEN bead that cannot be completed by automated processes.

DoD (Manual):
- Run system daily for 5 consecutive days
- Collect and document daily export results
- Record CM publishable rate (target ≥70% publishable)
- Document any issues or blockers discovered
- Decide what system changes are needed based on results

NOTE: This bead requires human operation and verification.
